entries.257b1147e9b48431: The 8th Medium-Term Management Plan, announced in May 2026, covers 3 years from fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2028. It aims to strengthen the 'Global Niche No.1' pillar and lists as priority measures strengthening the management foundation, further expanding and enriching 'Global Niche No.1' products, and creating new businesses by providing value unique to YASUNAGA CORPORATION. It also states that it aims to further increase the number of Global Niche No.1 products and to develop new sources of revenue through new businesses.
entries.25a04936a767c73e: The core of the plan is to expand market share and increase production capacity in Japan and overseas for existing products such as connecting rods, while developing new businesses that make use of micro-shape machining technology. The plan is structured to strengthen existing businesses and create new businesses at the same time.
